feature.name: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Put all lands from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield tapped
Infinite untap of lands you control

easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

feature.name: Put all permanent cards from your graveyard and library onto the battlefield

easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three lands.
You control at least two mana-producing lands, one of which can produce {U}.
description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land, adding one mana of any type that land can produce.
Repeat step 1 at least two more times, and more times if desired, ensuring to leave at least one land on the battlefield.
Activate Lumra by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Lumra enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Lumra.
Repeat.
